name: Basic Multi-Env Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ dev, uat, main ]

jobs:
  # 1. Dev Deployment Job
  dev-deploy:
    if: github.ref_name == 'dev'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Deploy to DEV
        run: echo "Hello! Ye DEV environment deployment hai."

  # 2. UAT Deployment Job
  uat-deploy:
    if: github.ref_name == 'uat'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Deploy to UAT
        run: echo "Hello! Ye UAT environment deployment hai."

  # 3. Prod Deployment Job
  prod-deploy:
    if: github.ref_name == 'main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Deploy to PROD
        run: echo "Hello! Ye PRODUCTION environment deployment hai."
